title: Way Properties.md is stale against its generator and carries 117 em-dashes

sections.what: The committed generated page `docs/virtualWorld/World Building/Way Properties.md` no longer matches its generator, and it carries 117 em-dash (U+2014) characters. `tests/test_way_property_index.py::test_generated_page_is_current` fails on a clean checkout because the generator now emits plain hyphens. Both the page and `tools/way_property_index.py` are unmodified in the working tree, so this is committed drift, not a local edit. Regenerate the page and keep the em-dash ban true in the generated output.
sections.why: Two separate problems in one artifact: (1) the repo-wide em-dash ban is violated in a committed doc, which is the exact character that has corrupted files under PowerShell and edit-tool surgery; (2) the generated page is stale, so a reader is looking at punctuation the generator no longer produces, and a pytest gate is red for everyone. `tools/way_property_index.py --check` exits 0, so the usual gate does not catch it: only the pytest currency test does.
sections.how: 1. Run `python tools/way_property_index.py --write` and inspect the diff: it should change punctuation only, no property rows. 2. Confirm the file contains zero U+2014. 3. Re-run `python -m pytest tests/test_way_property_index.py` and `python tools/way_property_index.py --check`. 4. Decide whether page currency belongs in the documented gate list next to `--check` (today only the pytest test enforces it), and record whichever answer is chosen where the gates are listed. Do not hand-edit the generated page.

acceptance.text: `python tools/way_property_index.py --write` regenerates `Way Properties.md` and the file contains 0 U+2014.
The regenerated page differs from the committed one in punctuation/normalisation only: the property rows and their baselined consumers are unchanged.
`python tools/way_property_index.py --check` still exits 0 after the regeneration.

The split between what `--check` verifies (declaration/consumer drift) and what the pytest test verifies (page currency) is written down where the gates are listed, so the next agent does not read `--check` as covering the page.
